name: corvus-skills
description: Agent skills for code care, security vetting, session routines, writing and thinking, by Alex.

plugins.name: security-skills
plugins.description: Vet third-party code before trusting it (vet-before-install) and keep pinned, patched copies of third-party skills (fork-keeper).

plugins.name: code-care-skills
plugins.description: Review, clean up and ship branches and whole projects: code-cleanup, branch-cleanup, branch-review, project-review and branch-ship.

plugins.name: session-routines
plugins.description: Open, plan, close and direct work sessions: resume-project, skill-picker, plan-admin, wrap-up and project-director.

plugins.name: thinking-skills
plugins.description: Raise the ambition of a task (aim-higher) and improve existing skills with clean dry runs (skill-improver).

plugins.name: obsidian-project-sync
plugins.description: Keep an Obsidian vault's project notes in step with the work done in each session, with a session-log hook.

plugins.name: workspace-setup
plugins.description: Set up a Claude Code project folder or a claude.ai Project that links to its sources instead of copying them.

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Clean AI-generated drafts in English and Spanish so they read as the writer's own text.
